hooks.name: Format, Lint & Type-check on Save
hooks.description: Runs formatter, linter, and type-checker after a TypeScript or Python file is saved (Kiro University Lesson 3, Hook A).

action.prompt: A source file was just saved. Run the appropriate formatter, linter, and type-checker for the changed file and fix any issues. For .ts/.tsx run prettier + eslint + `tsc --noEmit` in frontend/. For .py run black + ruff + mypy in backend/ (or infra/). Report only problems that need attention.
